full_judgment: Syed JR Mudassir Husain J: This appeal, by way of leave, arises out of judgment and order dated 12-4-2000 passed by a single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Order No. 1960 of 2000 summarily rejecting the appellants revisional application against the judgment and decree dated 28-7-1999 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka in Title Appeal No. 121 of 1999 reversing the judgment and decree dated 8-2-1999 passed by the learned Assistant Judge, Dohar Court, Dhaka in title Suit No. 27 of 1998 dismissing the same.
